description:
Get Bing Webmaster Tools summary for a property: clicks, impressions, CTR and average position for the period with the change versus the equal-length period before it, the daily clicks/impressions series, and the top queries and pages. Bing is a separate search engine counted differently from Google, so these numbers are never added to get_gsc_summary. ctr is a 0-1 fraction. status is "not_connected" until the property has a connected Bing site, and has_data is false while the first sync is still running. A date range is required: a preset (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d, at most 366 days). top_queries and top_pages hold up to limit rows each (default 10, max 100). A not_connected answer is not charged. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties. Returns feature_not_available when the Bing integration is not enabled.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Bing summary over the last 28 days.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","range":"last_28_days"}
```

limit.description: Rows of top_queries and top_pages, 1-100. Default 10.

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.

name: get_bing_summary

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

title: Bing summary
